g.text: Evolution graphs under exact bipartition balance

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #454545

g.text: Bars: median; whiskers: observed min–max. BURY has one result; other methods have 10 runs. Native SA needs all 10 sweeps within 30 s; it completes 10/10 unless a smaller count is shown.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #454545

g.text: Incumbents retain the best completed candidate, including initialization, even when a run reaches its time limit.
